Andaman Bay View Residences

Condominium in Chalong (Soi Chao Fa 46)
HomeSaleAndaman Bay View Residences

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions); the building was completed in 2025.

Project overview

Andaman Bay View Residences is a small condominium of 57 apartments in a single six-storey building on Soi Chao Fa 46 in Chalong, a short drive from Wat Chalong. The building was completed in 2025 and is distinguished by curved, planted balconies and interiors that use Thai textiles.

Apartments range from about 47 to 194 sqm, from one-bedroom suites to three-bedroom duplexes and a four-bedroom unit; recent listings show a 55 sqm one-bedroom and a 117 sqm three-bedroom. Residents have a rooftop pool and garden, a residents' bar, a gym on the fifth floor, a lobby with a cafe, key-card access, two lifts and 24-hour security.

Units are sold freehold within the foreign quota. Chalong's supermarkets, schools and the roads to Rawai, Kata and Phuket Town are within easy reach; the airport is about 54 minutes by car.
